# ramb

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

{ramb} provides tools for vessel-track (AIS/VMS) data and the steps of the ICES fishing-activity flow (WGSFD): flagging pings, creating port calls and voyages, building record windows, and gear, effort and catch handling. A function returns the construct it is given (a data frame, tibble, data.table, sf object or lazy DuckDB table) with the rows in the order they came in, and data frames and lazy DuckDB tables give the same result.

The multibeam-bathymetry raster and rayshading functions that used to live here moved to the sister package {omb} (`../omb`, functions prefixed `om_`) in 2026-10, and the movement-behaviour models moved to {fishymodel} (`../fishymodel`, functions prefixed `fm_`).

## Installation

You can install the development version of {ramb} from [GitHub](https://github.com/einarhjorleifsson/ramb) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("einarhjorleifsson/ramb")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(ramb)
```

```{r}
# great-circle distance in metres
rb_calc_distance(-21.93, 64.15, -23.93, 65.65)
```

```{r}
# the ICES statistical rectangle of a position
rb_encode_ices_rectangle(c(-10.5, 15.2), c(62.5, 54.9))
```
